Retract goes too far. Here's why.

She didn't take her claim back. She narrowed it to mild winters, and the right word has to mean exactly that.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Retract goes too far. To qualify a claim means to limit it.

youtube.title: SAT Words in Context Trap: Retract vs Qualify
youtube.description: Limiting a claim without withdrawing it is qualifying it. SAT-style practice question (original).
